name: ButtonGroup
description: Joins related Buttons into one visual unit with shared borders and rounded outer corners only, horizontal or vertical. Also the base for a split button and an icon toolbar.

label.description: Accessible name of the group, e.g. "Text formatting". Read when focus enters the group.

size.description: Size passed to every Button that does not set its own. A Button inside a MenuTrigger needs its own size.

children.description: Two or more Buttons, or a MenuTrigger holding a Button.

keyboard: Tab moves through the buttons one by one, in order
Enter or Space activates the focused button
A menu button opens its menu with Enter, Space or Arrow Down
requirements: The group has role group and an accessible name from label
Every button keeps its own accessible name; an icon-only button needs an aria-label
The focused button is raised above its neighbours so its focus ring is never covered by a shared border
Buttons keep their own disabled and pressed states; the group does not hide them
screenReader: Announced as a group with its label, then each button by name
A menu button is announced as a menu button, collapsed or expanded

use_when: Closely related actions that belong together, like Bold, Italic, Underline
A split button: a main action next to a menu of alternatives
avoid_when: Choosing one option from several: use SegmentedControl or ToggleButtonGroup
Unrelated actions: leave space between them
Many buttons that do not fit in one row: use a Menu
anti_patterns: Mixing several filled primary buttons in one group
A split button whose menu item repeats the main action
